capture_method: complete one-page list capture plus schedule configuration; safe columns only
privacy_note: Serials, model/manufacturer details, exact locations, supplier/team data, records, certificates, service reports, history, usage, comments, and attachments were omitted.
limitations: The list exposed status but not a separate active-state field; active_state is therefore not_exposed and status_is_in_service is a literal status interpretation.
The list exposed schedule names; configured intervals are authoritative in equipment_schedule_inventory.csv.
Required-assignment and availability behavior were not exposed.
General location was retained only at the site-level label.
